svg.text: Small multiples: every cold layout, six workloads
Protocol B published cases, cold regime. Hatched = non-steady (rails.steadiness). ⚠ = PROVISIONAL (≥2× spread vs own history).
ZFS random/mixed/sync ran on zvols, btrfs and mdadm on files: compare random IO within a stack, not across. Seq read/write (STO-01) is file-on-FS everywhere.
